description: Get results of Swiss popular votes (Volksabstimmungen) from Basel-Stadt open data. Returns vote title, date, yes/no counts, yes percentage, and eligible voters. Covers national and cantonal votes since 2021.

limit.description: Maximum number of votes to return (default: 10, max: 50).

year.description: Filter by year (e.g. 2024). If omitted, returns most recent votes.

name: get_voting_results
